about: Abstract planning components only. Replace bracketed placeholders with original wording and evidence before rendering. Source recordings are analysis-only.

hooks.name: Contrast planning components
hooks.pattern: Common advice vs the part nobody talks about
hooks.when_to_use: Advice or how-to content where the real insight contradicts the popular line. Strong opener for talking-head clips.

insert.note: Optional original or appropriately licensed production cutaway. Never use analysis-only reference footage.

hooks.name: Quiet Chapter planning components
hooks.pattern: Relatable, emotional: name the unglamorous stretch of a pursuit
hooks.when_to_use: Founder / creator / tradesperson journey content; pairs with slow, reflective b-roll or a selfie.

insert.note: Optional original or appropriately licensed production cutaway. Never use analysis-only reference footage.

hooks.name: Straight Talk planning components
hooks.pattern: Promise honesty, then name the topic
hooks.when_to_use: Myth-busting, pricing, reality-check content; lets the topic land as the second beat.

insert.note: Optional original or appropriately licensed production cutaway. Never use analysis-only reference footage.

hooks.name: Explained Fast planning components
hooks.when_to_use: Educational clips and carousels-turned-video; the number sets a promise the video must keep.

insert.note: Optional original or appropriately licensed production cutaway. Never use analysis-only reference footage.

hooks.name: Self Roast planning components
hooks.pattern: I do X for a living and still fail at Y
hooks.when_to_use: Personality-led content; disarming humour that buys attention for the lesson that follows.

insert.note: Optional original or appropriately licensed production cutaway. Never use analysis-only reference footage.

hooks.name: Pattern Interrupt planning components
hooks.pattern: Trend observation + a sudden cutaway image
hooks.when_to_use: Trend or industry commentary. The cutaway (meme, screenshot, b-roll still) breaks the pattern around 1.2s to re-grab attention.

insert.note: Optional original or appropriately licensed production cutaway. Never use analysis-only reference footage.
